releases.name: Field Twin 2026-11-07

jobs.description: A field log with a map, receipts, mileage, and an Android app that tracks stops.

releases.name: Pajamastan 2026-11-07
releases.body: Added a Links tab that includes the badge tool.

jobs.description: The official site of the micronation of Pajamastan.

releases.name: Rainbow Run 2026-11-07
releases.body: Added a stadium mode with a seating planner, and pictures and video that play on every screen, including YouTube videos and a stunt shared across the crowd. The host signs in, each room gets its own database, and entry kiosks give out one time seat tickets that a seat page can scan with the camera. Added a hype meter that turns the crowd red when phones shake. The microphone now drives the Spectral Engine scenes, and a floor virus spreads between phones that find each other by sound. The menu now has drop down sections.

jobs.description: A visualizer pedal where a pixel crow flies across phones lined up side by side

releases.name: Stompbox Lab 2026-11-07
releases.body: Added a stadium mode to the band server with a seating plan and picture and video cues for every screen. A demo cue runs an animation across the crowd, and show videos can be saved and timed with a beacon. The host signs in, each room gets its own database, and YouTube videos and stunts play on every screen. Added a hype meter, entry kiosks with one time seat tickets, and a floor virus that spreads between phones by sound.

jobs.description: A pedal board and synth with grooves that play across many phones.

releases.name: Badge Tool 2026-11-07
releases.body: Created the badge tool, a page for designing name badges. Added orientation tabs, saved templates with people for each template, a watermark image with background removal, text overlays, and a gradient editor with text angle. The layout editor drags and snaps, with style presets, card seals and patterns, a tilt preview, and more fonts. Email link login saves templates and people to the cloud, and a drawing reader turns a paper mockup into a layout.

jobs.description: A badge designer with templates, people, and a paper mockup reader.

releases.name: Stinkin Badges 2026-11-07
releases.body: Created the backend for the badge tool. It reads paper mockups with an AI model and saves to a shared cloud database. Sign in uses email links, and the badge tool is allowed as a return address.

jobs.description: The backend that reads badge mockups and saves badge data for the badge tool.
